difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a localisation of a normal domain is normal (statement lines 8264-8267). The proof clears denominators in an integrality relation over the localisation to obtain a relation over the base ring for a multiple of the element, applies normality of the base to that multiple, and reads off the conclusion (proof lines 8269-8280). Choosing the exponent to clear all denominators at once is the step that reduces the statement to the normality of the base. H2.
